long_biography.plain_text:
Guichelaar held both ownership and executive authority at the Spanish property company that carried his name. Its broad mandate allowed it to advise on investment, acquire or lease rural and urban assets, and undertake development for its own account or for clients.

His corporate footprint also extended to the Netherlands, where Rob Guichelaar Wieringerwerf B.V. traded in its own real estate. That company later used the name R.C.A. Project Beheer, matching his initials, and entered bankruptcy proceedings in 2015. The Spanish company subsequently faced provisional registry closure following removal from the corporate-entities tax index.
